checks.what: Two independent audits read all 813 cards against the MicrosoftDocs repositories they quote (checked word for word by the card checker) and the Microsoft Learn pages they are written from
checks.result: 58 scenario cards explained the options under the wrong letters after the right answer was moved; all were re-lettered, and the checker now catches this. Five cards re-teaching AZ-900 storage terms were deleted, the retired Data Migration Assistant is now labelled as retired, and 4 unsupported claims, 5 unclear cards and 7 minor issues were fixed.
